entries.title: Configuration format error
entries.summary: Configuration field types, value ranges or required-field relationships are invalid.
causes: Boolean, incorrect path or numeric field types
actions: Run Preflight on Setup
Check field or label in the error details
Restore the latest config.json.bak-* backup

entries.title: Profile invalid or incomplete
entries.summary: The environment, PDK or design profile cannot be resolved into an executable configuration.
causes: Explicitly selected Profile File does not exist
actions: Switch to automatic detection and rerun Preflight
Check the profile path and schema_version
Keep only advanced overrides required by the current PDK

entries.title: Configuration read/write failed
entries.summary: The configuration directory is unwritable, the file is corrupt, or atomic replacement failed.
actions: Check workspace permissions and free space
Restore from config.json.bak-*
Keep the workspace outside read-only PDK directories

entries.title: Preflight failed
entries.summary: At least one capability required for a live run is missing.
causes: Live mode lacks simulation configuration or submission command
Result workflow does not satisfy signoff conditions
actions: Inspect FAIL items in the Preflight matrix
Use Dry run to validate configuration first
Fill only unresolved fields in Advanced settings

entries.title: Automatic detection found no results
entries.summary: No Maestro, RDB, PSF or canonical bundle was found within the specified search directory and depth.
causes: Result directory naming or structure differs from current rules
actions: Confirm the project root
Increase scan depth in Advanced settings
Specify the RDB, PSF or canonical bundle path directly

entries.title: Automatic detection is ambiguous
entries.summary: Multiple equally credible VCO or replica candidates were found; the system will not guess.
causes: Multiple historical runs in one directory
actions: Select a candidate manually
Narrow the project root
Set main/replica TB matching rules in Advanced settings

entries.title: Input workflow fallback prohibited
entries.summary: The preferred RDB/PSF workflow is unavailable and configuration prohibits automatic fallback to CSV or a plain bundle.
causes: Only unaudited data discovered for CSV
actions: Repair the preferred workflow
Explicitly select manual canonical mode
Allow degraded fallback only for non-signoff jobs

entries.title: Physical profile inconsistent
entries.summary: The device-local instance, PSF hierarchy, four terminals, injection direction, model include/section, offset or source points do not match the execution engine.
causes: Interpreted netlist-local instance name as a full PSF hierarchy
Corner file include target not found in chain MOS subckt
UI offset or harmonic count differs from simulation configuration
Physical_profile missing or still legacy implicit value
actions: Inspect field and the first mismatch in Preflight details
Review target_instance, instance_path and drain_probe.trace separately for hierarchical devices
Let Preflight resolve include paths first; set device_subckt_file only if resolution fails
Add an explicit physical_profile to the engine JSON
Confirm that the VCO netlist exists for every point under source_root

entries.title: Maestro not selected or unreadable
entries.summary: The VCO or flicker-noise role is not bound to a valid maestro directory or maestro.sdb.
actions: Select the two existing Maestro setups manually on Setup
The path may identify a cell, maestro directory or maestro.sdb
Do not copy or modify OA to bypass read errors

entries.title: Maestro primary workflow capability missing
entries.summary: The selected test lacks an analysis, variable or output mapping required by its role.
causes: VCO Missing enabled HB, HBNOISE or differential output
VCO only PSS/PNOISE; This version can detect but bundled runner this workflow is not executed yet
Flicker TB did not retain standard noise analysis, or missing VGS/VDS/10 kHz override
Multiple test tied scores without manual selection
actions: Fill only the missing items reported by the UI
Use VCO HB/HBNOISE with the bundled runner; the ordinary flicker noise TB supplies the private periodic replica
Select the test name manually if multiple tests are present
Keep the original two-TB structure. PSS/PNOISE needs a validated custom adapter

entries.title: Dual-Maestro pairing error
entries.summary: Both roles point to the same setup, or their model/PDK roots differ.
causes: VCO and flicker the same item was mistakenly selected Maestro
Reused another PDK of flicker TB
ModelSetup still references an old machine/legacy PDK
actions: Select two independent testbenches using the same PDK
Check Maestro Model Libraries/Sections
Do not hide a PDK mismatch using final phase-noise values

entries.title: Maestro binding unconfirmed or changed
entries.summary: The fingerprint of variable names, output expressions, analyses, design or model sections differs from the saved binding.
causes: Detect & bind has not been clicked after initial selection
Variables or outputs renamed during migration
actions: Review changed and missing items in the UI
Confirm the changes, then click Rebind current settings
Restore unintended TB changes instead of deleting fingerprints

entries.title: Executable Maestro History unavailable
entries.summary: Live execution could not locate a completed VCO or flicker History with both generated netlists and PSF results.
causes: RDB rawDir still points to old-machine paths
Only copied rdb/log, not copied point/test Result
Selected setup has not run on this machine VCO or flicker Maestro
Only prepared contract fixture, No production data provided for flicker Maestro/history
actions: Run the VCO and flicker Maestro/test selections on this machine
Refresh detection and confirm complete run counts and History fingerprints for both roles
Do not edit RDB rawDir, copy incomplete point directories or fabricate .simDone

entries.title: Maestro/RDB/PSF Discovery failed
entries.summary: The result directory is unreadable, the RDB is not a valid SQLite file, or a read-only query failed.
causes: Path does not exist or permission denied
actions: Check paths and read permissions
Open the corresponding History in Maestro and check integrity
Use an explicit PSF or canonical path while preserving raw results

entries.title: Simulation results are incomplete
entries.summary: The exact point/test PSF lacks .simDone, spectre.out or a zero-error completion marker.
actions: Inspect spectre.out for the exact point/test
Wait for cluster collection to complete
Do not fabricate .simDone

entries.title: Result Bundle Import failed
entries.summary: Canonical CSV, metadata or harmonic relationships violate the calculation contract.
causes: Main VCO and replica point sets differ
actions: Check path, point and missing fields in the error details
Rerun the extraction stage
Do not manually edit a signoff bundle

entries.title: Provenance or hash validation failed
entries.summary: The bundle belongs to another job, a file changed, results are stale, or the PSF logs are unreliable.
causes: File in manifest modified after generation
PSF located in current run_root outside
actions: Use the current job private output directory
Rerun extraction
Check the SHA-256 values for manifest.json and spectre.out

entries.title: Physical-unit or normalization contract failed
entries.summary: PSD/ASD, peak/RMS, SSB/DSB, current direction or shared-noise-source definitions disagree.
actions: Check unit fields in metadata.json
Check drain_to_source direction
First compare physical units: Vout=sum(Hk*Ink)

entries.title: Signoff export quality gate failed
entries.summary: Signoff export was requested, but design-point count, Spectre numerical quality, PM projection prerequisites or an explicitly enabled HBAC gate failed the contract.
causes: Spectre.out includes failure to detect steady state, unreliable model results or convergence warnings
Target device AM relative to PM too large, total output magnitude cannot be treated as PM
Configuration requires HBAC secondary validation with excessive phase difference
actions: For single-point or smoke runs use --smoke or --non-signoff, retain the job ID and export replay evidence
Pass --formal-signoff only for intended signoff with at least six real design points; formal export also requires a job ID
Inspect numerical_quality_*, pm_magnitude_* and hbac_* in summary.csv
Fix simulation quality and rerun. Do not edit metadata or delete warnings

entries.title: Submission adapter configuration error
entries.summary: The local or cluster submission adapter lacks a command, environment or stage definition.
actions: Select bundled/local/cluster in Advanced settings
Check adapter configuration
Inspect execution commands reported by Preflight

entries.title: Command template error
entries.summary: The command contains a disallowed, missing or malformed template variable.
causes: Variable is not in the fixed allowlist
actions: Inspect variable and allowed in error details
Use the default command generated by the UI
Do not embed unescaped dynamic shell fragments in templates

entries.title: Cannot start external command
entries.summary: The simulator or scheduler command is missing, is not executable, or has an invalid working directory.
actions: Run Preflight to confirm the executable
Set an absolute path in the environment profile
Check working-directory permissions

entries.title: External command timed out
entries.summary: A local command or cluster poll exceeded the configured timeout.
causes: Poll command cannot identify completion status
actions: Check stage logs and scheduler status
Fix simulation before resuming the job
Increase timeout in Advanced settings if needed

entries.title: External command failed
entries.summary: Simulation, waveform exchange, extraction or validation returned a nonzero exit code.
causes: Spectre syntax, Model, license or convergence errors
Automatic DC-noise sample contributor trace/device parameters mismatch
Main VCO hierarchy probe or HBXF trace does not exist
actions: Inspect stage stdout/stderr and the earliest Spectre error
For exchange failures, check dc_flicker/sample_*/psf/spectre.out and traces.dc_noise
For VCO/replica failures, check profile hierarchy, model includes and device parameters
Locate the cause using returncode in error details
Resume only if the contract is unchanged; after changing profiles or netlists, create a new job

entries.title: Cluster stage protocol failed
entries.summary: The submit/poll/collect/verify protocol did not produce a valid job ID or completion status.
causes: Poll State is neither success nor failure
actions: Check stage commands listed by Preflight
Adjust the job-ID and status regular expressions
Prefer the existing synchronous cluster wrapper

entries.title: Cannot resume job
entries.summary: The job has no resumable snapshot, its state prevents resuming, or its run directory is missing.
causes: Legacy job did not save request snapshot
actions: Check job.json and .isf_run_state.json
Retain the original job as evidence and create a new job
Do not move active private run directories

entries.title: Resume contract mismatch
entries.summary: Current configuration, commands or inputs differ from the original job snapshot; completed stages cannot be skipped.
causes: Used the same configuration in another environment run_root
actions: Restore the original configuration and retry
Use a new run_root for a new job
Compare contract_sha256 in job.json

entries.title: Job does not exist
entries.summary: The requested job ID does not exist in the current workspace.
causes: Entered data from another environment job ID
actions: Select again from the job list
Confirm the workspace used when starting the UI
Do not reuse job IDs across environments

entries.title: Job results are not ready
entries.summary: The job is queued, running or waiting for result collection.
actions: Inspect stage status on the run page
Wait for automatic refresh
If status remains unchanged, inspect the stage log

entries.title: Job execution failed
entries.summary: The job failed. Its specific cause is recorded in cause_code and the stage logs.
causes: Preflight, Submit, Extraction or calculation stage failed
actions: Inspect cause_code first
Resume after fixing the cause
Keep the original logs

entries.title: Unclassified internal error
entries.summary: An unclassified exception occurred. The tool will not treat it as an available result.
actions: Save job.json, error details and logs
Record environment information with the local error code
Do not use this job for signoff

entries.title: NumPy unavailable
entries.summary: The UI, configuration and lightweight checks work, but automatic PSF extraction and FFT may be unavailable.
causes: NumPy is not installed in the current Python environment
actions: Use an existing compatible Python environment
Use manual canonical bundle import
Do not change Python inside the Cadence subprocess environment

entries.title: PDK not detected
entries.summary: The PDK identity was not detected. Read-only checks and manual import can continue.
causes: PDK located at a nonstandard path
actions: Set the PDK name or root in Advanced settings
Do not copy the entire PDK into the tool directory
Confirm model includes before live execution

entries.title: Using fallback input workflow
entries.summary: The current input uses CSV or a plain bundle instead of the preferred RDB/PSF provenance workflow.
actions: Retain the NON-SIGNOFF marker in reports
Use RDB/PSF again when signoff evidence is needed
Confirm that units and time-origin metadata are complete

entries.title: Maestro Mappings need confirmation
entries.summary: The primary analysis exists, but VBS, a 10 kHz output or another optional logical name cannot be mapped uniquely.
causes: Variable names differ from common VGS/VDS/VBS naming differs
Output expression has no explicit 10 kHz
Bulk/source in the original TB shorted by default in
actions: Prefer an existing variable/output from detected candidates
Record the VBS=0 assumption when applicable
Fill only unresolved fields in Advanced mappings

entries.title: Maestro requires private analysis override
entries.summary: The selected testbench did not directly save 10 kHz, HBXF/PXF or HBAC/PAC. The runner adds the required analysis in a private netlist copy.
causes: VCO HBNOISE start frequency above 10 kHz
actions: Allow analysis additions only in private run_root copies
For direct Maestro History reads, add the frequency or analysis to the original TB explicitly
HBAC/PAC is secondary validation only, never a reverse fit

entries.title: Maestro history path is stale
entries.summary: RDB metadata are readable, but rawDir, point/test PSF or generated netlists still refer to an old host.
causes: User name or simulation root directory changed
Legacy history located on an unmounted shared disk
actions: Read-only checks can still review the TB contract
Rerun the selected Maestro locally before simulation
Retain the old RDB as historical evidence without editing its path fields

entries.title: Thermal noise calculation unavailable
entries.summary: Independent thermal calculation lacks verifiable data or encountered an unsupported model or convention. Flicker results remain available; missing thermal noise is not represented by zero.
causes: Missing positive/negative sidebands or source noise PSD
Simulator or primitive outside independent validation scope
MOS white noise/period or provenance check failed
actions: Inspect thermal_noise.reason and private thermal logs
Check actual terminals, saved items and model support
Create a new job after repair; do not infer calculation gain from total HBNoise

entries.title: Cross-design-point trend failed
entries.summary: Absolute closure may pass, but error variation from the median exceeds the trend threshold.
actions: Inspect Qk cumulative sums and phase sensitivity
Increase design points and harmonic order
Use HBAC/PAC for secondary validation

entries.title: Spectre numerical quality warning
entries.summary: Spectre finished with zero errors, but explicit log warnings make numerical signoff unreliable.
causes: Model linearized outside its range and results declared incorrect
actions: Inspect the stage and spectre.out indicated by numerical_quality_issues
Adjust tstab, initial conditions, model validity range or operating point, then rerun
Use current results only for workflow or portability smoke checks

entries.title: HBAC secondary phase-validation deviation
entries.summary: The relative phase difference between HBAC/PAC deterministic injection and HBNOISE AM/PM engineering candidates exceeds the configured threshold.
causes: Injection location and actual internal flicker source not fully equivalent
actions: Retain every candidate in phase_candidates.csv
Review injection location, sidebands and the common time reference
Do not select quadrants using final VCO noise; HBAC remains a secondary diagnostic by default

entries.title: Output PM projection prerequisites insufficient
entries.summary: Target-device AM is no longer much smaller than PM. The complex output-sideband magnitude cannot be labeled directly as PM-noise ASD.
causes: Incorrect carrier or differential-output reference selection
Requires complete AM/PM covariance or a determined PM projection
actions: Check spectre_am_to_pm_dB against the configured threshold
Review differential carrier, PM/SSB output and carrier phase
Until actual PM projection is established, retain only physical output-noise magnitude and prohibit formal signoff
